settings.subtitle: Origin & Manifesto
settings.title: Architectural Restraint. Pure Materiality.
settings.quote: We craft enduring spatial objects that bring tactile serenity to modern technological life.
settings.body_text: Founded in Milan with engineering studios in Tokyo, Atelier was born from a desire to strip away superficial noise and focus purely on materials, micro-tolerances, and human proportion.

settings.heading: Aerospace Grade 5 Titanium
settings.text: Every pedestal and housing is CNC-machined from solid billet titanium with 0.02mm tolerances, followed by multi-pass hand polishing and satin bead-blasting.
